it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e assumiu a prefeitura em 03/04/2026, quando passou a valer a renúncia de Tião Bocalom, que deixou o cargo para disputar a eleição de 2026 para governador do Acre. A cerimônia de transmissão do cargo foi em 04/04/2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and became mayor on April 3, 2026, when the resignation of Mayor Tião Bocalom took effect; Bocalom left office to run for governor of Acre state in the 2026 election. The handover ceremony was held on April 4, 2026.

it.txt: Era vice-prefeito. Assumiu a prefeitura de forma interina em 02/04/2026, quando João Campos renunciou ao cargo para disputar a eleição de 2026 para governador de Pernambuco, e tomou posse como prefeito em 06/04/2026, na Câmara Municipal.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor. He took charge of the city on an acting basis on April 2, 2026, when Mayor João Campos resigned to run for governor of Pernambuco state in the 2026 election, and was sworn in as mayor on April 6, 2026, at the City Council (the city's legislature).
